register.notes: No state packaging register — RWS UPV registers cover other streams. Packaging obligations are handled entirely through Verpact (formerly Afvalfonds Verpakkingen).

pro.ecoModulation: SUP surcharge on top of base rates.

notes: Indicative 2025 figures (unverified): paper ~€0.017/kg, plastic >€1/kg, aluminium ~€300/t. High plastic rate is deliberate steering. Pull the Verpact tariff page in the verification batch.
